title: Pillowy Russian Bread Bowl
description: A unique Indian-inspired bread bowl recipe featuring pillowy bread as the base. This recipe is perfect for serving soups or salads.
instructions: Cut the pillowy bread into small bowls.
Drizzle the olive oil over the bread bowls and season with salt.
Bake the bread bowls in the oven for 10-12 minutes, or until lightly toasted.
In a separate bowl, mix together the quenched yogurt and chopped Russian dill.
Spoon the yogurt mixture over the bread bowls and serve with bread bows on the side.
